precepts.text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High, which is the Bible, shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty, the protection we get.
precepts.point: The Most High shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

precepts.why:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High is the Bible, and the shadow of the Almighty is the protection we get. That is the same shade in “The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.”

He is our keeper and our protector, and the shade is the protection he gives, so that the sun shall not smite by day nor the moon by night.

precepts.text: To them that are sanctified by God the Father and preserved in Jesus Christ; we are preserved by the laws of the Most High and the faith in Christ.
precepts.point: The Most High shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

precepts.why:
Jude writes “to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called”. That is how “The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.” We are preserved by keeping the laws of the Most High in the faith of Christ.

Sanctified by the Father, preserved in Christ: that preserving covers our going out and our coming in, “from this time forth, and even for evermore.”

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the Most High, which made heaven and earth. Our help comes from Him; we cannot do this by ourselves.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

points: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber. Behold, He that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The Most High keeps watch over Israel without slumbering.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

points: The Most High is thy keeper; the Most High is thy shade upon thy right hand. He is our keeper, our protector, and the shade is the protection He gives, the same as the shadow of the Almighty in Psalm 91.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

points: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night. The Most High shall preserve thee from all evil; He shall preserve thy soul. We are preserved by keeping His laws in the faith of Christ.

note.label: Psalm 121: My Help Cometh From the Lord

points: The Most High shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
